summary: As SDDP Executive Director, Ahlers directed a party statement acknowledging Hamas Oct 7 attack but emphasizing 30,000+ Gaza civilian deaths and calling for continued pressure on Israel to end hostilities.
quote: The actions by Israel to defend itself have led to the deaths of more than 30,000 people in Gaza, many of whom are children. The war has also displaced 2 million people, leaving many without shelter, food or water.
